serverState.note: LAB-PLAN 2.6. states: every state state() and noteError() can return (a closed set). fromStatus: a GET /v1/status body and a feature -> stateFromStatus: ready; needs-key, needs-domain, needs-r2, needs-lab-inbox, needs-paid and locked with the module’s text; anything else is error, with the server’s message when it is a non-empty string. fromError: the server’s answer to a call ({status, body}: body is the response text), a network failure, a gate’s deadline, or a state the app decides before any request -> the error the client makes (code, HTTP status and the fields it keeps; a code is read only when it matches ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,39}$ and is not OFFLINE, else the error is BAD_AUTH for 401 and SERVER_ERROR otherwise) -> stateFromError -> {state, message}; noteError(feature, error) returns the same and does `noteError` to a fresh cached status in which every feature is ready (fromStatus[0].status), with the storage keys in `before` set too: kept; updated (that feature now holds `expect`, and server/statusAt is removed so the next state() refreshes); or dropped (server/status and server/statusAt removed). For dropped, badAuthAt is server/badAuthAt afterwards (null: absent; the first BAD_AUTH of an episode sets it to now, STATE_NOW) and configRefresh says whether server/configAt was removed, so that the next discovery re-reads the config topic: only when server/badAuthAt was absent. A successful GET /v1/status removes server/badAuthAt.

setupLinks.note: formatSetupLink(server, secret) = server origin + "/setup#SETUP-" + base32(secret ‖ check) in groups of 4, check = SHA-256("dlshare/v1/server-setup-check" ‖ 0x00 ‖ secret)[0]. setupToken = hex(SHA-256("dlshare/v1/server-setup-auth" ‖ 0x00 ‖ secret)), sent as Authorization: Bearer on POST /v1/setup with {"code": <the Server code>}. parseSetupLink ignores case, spaces, dashes, dots and underscores in the fragment and reads 0, 1 and 8 as O, I and B; error reasons: format, checksum, server-code, pairing-code.
